sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the inverse Z-transform of } \frac{z}{z-0.5} \text{ by long division method for } |z| > 0.5.\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Perform division: } \frac{z}{z-2} = 1 + 2z^{-1} + 4z^{-2} + 8z^{-3} + \cdots\)

(3 Mark)

\(\text{So } x(n) = 2^n u(n) = \{1, 2, 4, 8, \ldots\}\)

(2 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{Find the inverse Z-transform of } \frac{z}{z-2} \text{ by long division for } |z| > 2.\)

lq.ANSWER:
StepMarks

a) \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1 - 0.5z^{-1}} = \frac{z}{z-0.5}\), ROC: |z|>0.5 (right-sided).
Perform long division for |z|>0.5 (i.e., in powers of \(z^{-1}\)):
Write \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1 - 0.5z^{-1}}\).
\(1 \div (1 - 0.5z^{-1})\):
Quotient: \(1 + 0.5z^{-1} + 0.25z^{-2} + 0.125z^{-3} + ... = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (0.5)^n z^{-n}\).
So, \(x(n) = (0.5)^n u(n)\).

(5 Marks)

b) \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1-2z} = -\frac{1}{2z} \cdot \frac{1}{1 - (1/(2z))}\), ROC: |z|<0.5 implies |1/(2z)|>1? Actually, for ROC |z|<0.5, we expand in positive powers of z (left-sided sequence).
Write: \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1-2z}\). For |2z|<1 i.e., |z|<0.5, we have \(X(z) = 1 + 2z + 4z^2 + 8z^3 + ... = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} 2^n z^n\).
But this corresponds to \(X(z) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^{0} x(n) z^{-n}\). Let m = -n. Then \(X(z)=\sum_{m=0}^{\infty} x(-m) z^{m}\).
Comparing: \(x(-m) = 2^m\) or \(x(n) = 2^{-n}\) for \(n \le 0\). Equivalently, \(x(n) = -2^n u(-n-1)\) (left-sided).

(5 Marks)

c) \(X(z) = \frac{z}{z^2 - 3z + 2} = \frac{z}{(z-1)(z-2)}\), ROC: |z|>2 (right-sided).
Perform long division for |z|>2: Divide z by (z^2 - 3z + 2).
We want \(X(z)\) as a series in \(z^{-1}\).
\(X(z) = z^{-1} \cdot \frac{1}{1 - 3z^{-1} + 2z^{-2}}\).
Divide 1 by (1 - 3z^{-1} + 2z^{-2}):
Quotient: \(1 + 3z^{-1} + 7z^{-2} + 15z^{-3} + 31z^{-4} + ...\).
So, \(X(z) = z^{-1}(1 + 3z^{-1} + 7z^{-2} + 15z^{-3} + 31z^{-4} + ...) = z^{-1} + 3z^{-2} + 7z^{-3} + 15z^{-4} + 31z^{-5} + ...\).
Thus, \(x(0)=0, x(1)=1, x(2)=3, x(3)=7, x(4)=15, x(5)=31, ...\).
This corresponds to \(x(n) = (2^n - 1) u(n-1)\).

(5 Marks)
lq.QUESTION_DESC:
Find the inverse Z-transform of the following by long division (power series) method. Also, specify the ROC and the nature of the sequence (right-sided/left-sided).

a) \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1 - 0.5z^{-1}}\), ROC: \(|z| > 0.5\)

b) \(X(z) = \frac{1}{1 - 2z}\), ROC: \(|z| < 0.5\)

c) \(X(z) = \frac{z}{z^2 - 3z + 2}\), ROC: \(|z| > 2\)
